Patches.Title: Bug Fixes & Improved Audio & Improved Indoor Lighting
Patches.PatchNotes:
## Changes

- Fixed Almost All Bugs Reported
- Improved Weapon Sounds (Tails + Better Indoor vs Exterior Differentiation)
- Improved Indoor Lighting For Non Lumen 
- Added All Missions To Start From CommandMenu -> Easier For Debugging

Patches.Title: In Raid Trader & Secure Container
Patches.PatchNotes:
## Gameplay
- NEW In Raid Trader (on delta, items to trader are temporary, bring cash!)
- NEW In Raid Secure Container (next to trader, for a fee place items that are later delivered to message box)
- NEW Item Swapping (any item in inventory can be now swapped, finally!)

## Content
- More progress on outskirts

## Fixes
- Most discord reports fixed
- Much improved item dropping for clients (especially gear lands predictable in front of player, no more issues with floating gear)

Patches.Title: Convoy & Airdrop
Patches.PatchNotes:
## Gameplay 
- NEW Convoy & Airdrop Operation (only on Delta atm)
- NEW LRF (Laser Range Finder - needed for Convoy)

## Content
- More detailing on Outskirts

## Fixes
- Many bugfixes for reported issues via discord
- Reduced package size to 33 GB temporarily. Need to do further testing on effects and if we can keep that.
